items.name: core
items.title: Raya Core
items.description: Token-to-Tailwind bridge and component classes shared by every System. Required by all Raya items.
items.docs:
Import in your styles.css AFTER `@import "tailwindcss"` and BEFORE any System stylesheet:

@import "./styles/raya/core.css";

items.name: raya-fonts
items.title: Raya Fonts
items.description: Optional font wiring for the five built-in Raya faces (Inter, Space Grotesk, Instrument Serif, JetBrains Mono, Geist Mono). Skip if you self-host per System export instructions.
items.docs:
Import in your styles.css (anywhere after tailwindcss):

@import "./styles/raya/fonts.css";

items.name: baseline
items.title: Raya System: Baseline
items.description: Raya's default look — quiet, rounded, blue-violet accent.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Raya System: Terminal
items.description: Monospaced, square-cornered, phosphor green on near-black.
